scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.predev:backend: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=process.platform==='win32'?'backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe':'backend/venv/bin/python';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('\nBackend venv not found. Run: npm run setup:backend\n');process.exit(1)}"
